content: {"argument": "The changed condition `(options.keepQueryParameters.length - 1) > 0` evaluates to false when the array length is 1, because 1 - 1 = 0, and 0 > 0 is false. This causes the loop that filters query parameters to be skipped when exactly one parameter is to be kept, resulting in no filtering occurring. The original condition `options.keepQueryParameters.length > 0` correctly handled arrays of length 1 or more. This is a clear unintended regression introduced by the refactor.", "concedes": true}
